The '''Backstab War''' was a conflict which led to the [[Wikipedia:Secession|secession]] of the southern provinces (mainly the former [[Southern Laselteh]]) from the [[Laselteh|Republic of Laselteh]] and the establishment of an independent [[First Republic of Grazail]].

The people of the south were mainly [[Vaver people|Vaver]] and [[Dabdan people|Dabdan]]. Both peoples were traditionally ___ as contrasted with ____-dominated people of the north. Many outspoken liberals, including the Grazail family from which the nation is named, regarded [[Tyidai Idueria]] rule as despotic. There were high levels of [[Wikipedia:Unemployment|unemployment]] and industrial unrest among the working classes.<ref>E.H. Eollycalann, ''The Backstab War 1654 - 1655'' (1722) pp. 151–154</ref>

On 22 January 1654, riots erupted in [[Mushira]] and shops were looted. [[Wikipedia:Theatre|Theatregoers]] who had just watched the nationalistic opera ''[[Lio Eulaellom Isur]]'' joined the mob. Uprisings followed elsewhere in the country. Factories were occupied and machinery destroyed. Order was restored briefly after Idueria committed troops to the [[Southern Provinces (Laselteh)|Southern Provinces]], but rioting continued, and leadership was taken up by radicals, who started talking of secession.<ref>Paul W. Schroeder, ''The Transformation of Atirhan Politics 1600–1700'' (1734) pp. 671–691.</ref>

Laseltshen units saw mass desertion of recruits from the southern provinces and pulled out. On 22 March, a newly formed Provisional Government in [[Mushira]] declared independence and called for the election of a [[Union of Grazail]].<ref>Riaralnu Saelisuir Yasur, ''Revolt in the Mii: Mushira, 1655'' (1735) p. 99.</ref>. Following the installation of [[Haena Grazail]] as High Minister of the Grazailite state in 1656, [[Tyidai Idueria]] made a belated attempt to reconquer [[Grazail]] and restore his position through a military campaign. This Campaign failed because of [[Etirha|Etirha's]] military intervention, which pulled in [[Pelan]], which was occupied by Etirha a week later. The Laseltshen High Minister surrendered after the [[Battle of Raeral]] was defeated and accepted the declaration of Grazailite independence in 1656 by signing the [[Treaty of Zayden]].
